title: Find the names of cards that have a Japanese translation, are part of a due
question: Find the names of cards that have a Japanese translation, are part of a duel deck labeled 'b', and have unknown power (either NULL or '*'). Among these, return only those with the highest converted mana cost.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c."XCL_049"
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c."XCL_012" = 'b'
  AND (c."XCL_055" IS NULL OR c."XCL_055" = '*')
  AND c."XCL_063" IN (
    SELECT st."XCL_093"
    FROM set_translations AS st
    WHERE st."XCL_092" = 'Japanese'
  )
  AND c."XCL_011" = (
    SELECT MAX(c2."XCL_011")
    FROM cards AS c2
    WHERE c2."XCL_012" = 'b'
      AND (c2."XCL_055" IS NULL OR c2."XCL_055" = '*')
      AND c2."XCL_063" IN (
        SELECT st2."XCL_093"
        FROM set_translations AS st2
        WHERE st2."XCL_092" = 'Japanese'
      )
  );
